description.value:
Frequency at will

Attempt a Stealth check to Hide from your Marked quarry specifically, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus (+4 at Veteran, +6 at Undying) and ignoring the normal requirement for cover or concealment against it. On success you're undetected by that quarry alone; other creatures perceive you as normal.

cinderfall.incomplete: Base +2 circumstance bonus to Hide vs. your Marked quarry is built (target:mark:quarry, matching pf2e's own Hunt Prey action:seek/action:track predicate convention). The tiered escalation (+4 at "Veteran", +6 at "Undying") is NOT built: those tier names appear on exactly 7 Waywarden cards (this one, Silent Verdict, The Long Wait, Widowmaker's Choice, Threading the Needle, Crossbite, Scissor Strike) and are undefined everywhere else in the corpus -- checked classes.waywarden.json's own terms/features, site/pages/waywarden.html (whose 'feat-tier' headings are character-level brackets, unrelated), and lore/ for any Blooded/Veteran/Undying level-band definition; none exists. Building the escalation would mean guessing arbitrary level thresholds, so it's left as a decision point rather than authored blind. Also left as flavor/player-adjudicated text, matching real pf2e's own precedent (class-features/camouflage-pigmentation.json ships "Hide even without cover or concealment" with rules: [] too): ignoring the cover/concealment requirement to Hide, and that success makes you undetected by the quarry alone.
